He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson Tigers]] and [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette Golden Eagles]]. ==Early life and high school== Prosper grew up in [[Montreal]], [[Quebec]], Canada.{{cite web |date=January 10, 2022 |title=Marquette's Olivier-Maxence Prosper latest Montreal basketball talent |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/01/10/marquettes-olivier-maxence-prosper-latest-montreal-basketball-talent/9155852002/ |url-access=subscription |access-date=May 7, 2023 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]}} Prosper's father Gaetan moved to Montreal from [[Haiti]] as a child.{{cite web |last=Steele |first=Ben |date=June 20, 2023 |title=Olivier-Maxence Prosper made up his mind at a young age that he would reach the NBA. That will happen for the Marquette star on Thursday |url=https://eu.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2023/06/20/marquettes-olivier-maxence-prosper-will-join-montreal-friend-ben-mathurin-in-nba/70334381007/ |url-access=subscription |access-date=June 23, 2023 |website=Milwaukee Journal Sentinel |language=en}} He initially attended L'Académie Ste-Thérèse, which did not have a basketball team.{{cite web |last=Rouleau |first=François-David |date=December 27, 2019 |title=Académie de la NBA: Olivier-Maxence Prosper est tombé dans la potion dès son enfance |url=https://www.journaldemontreal.com/2019/12/27/tombe-dans-la-potion-des-son-enfance |access-date=May 7, 2023 |work=[[Le Journal de Montréal]] |language=fr}} When Prosper was 16 he enrolled at [[Lake Forest Academy]] in [[Lake Forest, Illinois]].{{cite web |last=Sadin |first=Steve |date=August 3, 2019 |title=From Montreal to Medellin: Lake Forest Academy junior thrives at Basketball Without Borders camp |url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/lake-forest/sports/ct-lfr-oliver-maxence-prosper-basketball-without-borders-tl-0808-20190803-j4yzclhjsfa47ichus4gy3phy4-story.html |access-date=May 5, 2023 |work=[[Chicago Tribune]]}} Prosper transferred to the [[NBA Academy]] Latin America in [[Mexico City]], Mexico to finish his high school career.{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4312175/2023/03/16/bennedict-mathurin-latin-american-academy-indiana-pacers/|title=How the Latin American NBA Academy helped save Bennedict Mathurin|first=Joe|last=Vardon|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=March 16, 2023|access-date=May 5, 2023}} He was rated a four-star recruit and committed to play [[college basketball]] at [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]].{{cite web|url=https://usatodayhss.com/2019/clemson-adds-another-major-basketball-recruit-in-4-star-f-olivier-maxence-prosper|title=Clemson adds another major basketball recruit in 4-star F Olivier-Maxence Prosper|first=Cam|last=Smith|work=[[USA Today]]|date=October 25, 2019|access-date=May 7, 2023}} ==College career== Prosper began his college career at [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/10/28/marquette-basketballs-olivier-maxence-prosper-could-help-scoring-load/69598233007/|title=Marquette basketball's Olivier-Maxence Prosper could help scoring load|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=October 24, 2022|access-date=May 5, 2023}} He averaged ten minutes of play and 2.5 points per game as a freshman.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/clemson/mens-basketball/clemson-tigers-freshman-olivier-maxence-prosper-enters-transfer-portal|title=Clemson's Prosper Enters Transfer Portal|first=Brad|last=Senkiw|website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=March 24, 2021|access-date=May 5, 2023}} After the season, Prosper entered the [[NCAA]] transfer portal.{{cite web |last=Shanesy |first=Todd |date=March 24, 2021 |title=Clemson basketball loses Olivier-Maxence Prosper to transfer portal; second player this week |url=https://www.greenvilleonline.com/story/sports/2021/03/24/clemson-basketball-loses-olivier-maxence-prosper-ncaa-transfer-portal/6989247002/ |access-date=May 5, 2023 |work=[[The Greenville News]]}} Prosper ultimately transferred to [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]].{{cite web |last=Steele |first=Ben |date=April 15, 2021 |title=Marquette adds Clemson transfer Olivier-Maxence Prosper |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2021/04/15/marquette-adds-clemson-transfer-olivier-maxence-prosper/7235346002/ |access-date=May 5, 2023 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]}} He averaged 6.6 points and 3.3 rebounds in his first season with the Golden Eagles.{{cite web |date=June 16, 2022 |title=Olivier-Maxence Prosper, Oso Ighodaro have bigger roles for Marquette |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/06/16/olivier-maxence-prosper-oso-ighodaro-have-bigger-roles-for-marquette-golden-eagles/7639510001/ |url-access=subscription |access-date=May 7, 2023 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]}} Prosper averaged 12.5 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 0.9 steals per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://ftw.usatoday.com/2023/04/nba-draft-olivier-maxence-prosper-sleeper-marquette|title=Why NBA teams looking for the next OG Anunoby should consider drafting Olivier-Maxence Prosper|first=Bryan|last=Kalbrosky|website=[[USA Today]]|date=April 12, 2023|access-date=May 7, 2023}} After the season, he entered the [[2023 NBA draft]],{{cite web |last=Steele |first=Ben |date=April 12, 2023 |title=Marquette's Olivier-Maxence Prosper puts name into 2023 NBA draft |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2023/04/12/marquettes-olivier-maxence-prosper-puts-name-into-nba-draft/70107462007/ |access-date=May 5, 2023 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]}} showcasing impressive performances at the [[NBA Draft Combine]]. ==Professional career== Prosper was drafted 24th overall by the [[Sacramento Kings]] in the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last=Nacion |first=Chicco |date=June 23, 2023 |title=Kings select Olivier-Maxence Prosper, reportedly trade him, Holmes to Mavs |url=https://www.thescore.com/nba/news/2661234/amp |access-date=June 25, 2023 |website=TheScore.com}} Shortly after, his draft rights were traded, along with [[Richaun Holmes]], to the [[Dallas Mavericks]] in exchange for cash considerations{{cite web|title=Sacramento Kings Complete Trade With Dallas Mavericks|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/sacramento-kings-complete-trade-with-dallas-mavericks|website=NBA.com|date=July 6, 2023|access-date=July 6, 2023}} and on July 16, 2023, he signed with the Mavericks.{{cite web |last=Falcon |first=Julia |date=July 16, 2023 |title=Dallas Mavericks sign first-round pick Olivier-Maxence Prosper |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/dallas-mavericks-sign-first-round-pick-olivier-maxence-prosper/ |access-date=July 16, 2023 |website=cbsnews.com}} On November 11, Prosper was assigned to the Mavericks’ [[NBA G League|G League]] affiliate, the [[Texas Legends]].{{Cite web |last=Stinar |first=Ben |date=November 11, 2023 |title=Dallas Mavericks Make A Roster Move |url=https://www.si.com/fannation/nba/fastbreak/news/dallas-mavericks-make-a-roster-move-olivier-maxence-prosper |access-date=November 11, 2023 |website=Fastbreak on FanNation |language=en}} On April 14, 2024, in the Mavericks' season finale against the [[2023–24 Detroit Pistons season|Detroit Pistons]], Prosper earned his first career start, logging 16 points, 6 rebounds, and 2 steals in 29 minutes.{{Cite web|title=Dallas Mavs' Jaden Hardy, O-Max Prosper Face Major Development Test Against OKC Thunder|url=https://www.si.com/nba/mavericks/news/dallas-mavs-jaden-hardy-olivier-maxence-prosper-development-test-oklahoma-city-thunder|access-date=April 16, 2024|website=si.com|language=en}} Later in the season, the Mavericks, along with Prosper, reached the [[2024 NBA Finals]]; they subsequently lost to the [[2023–24 Boston Celtics season|Boston Celtics]] in five games.{{cite web|title=Boston Celtics defeat Dallas Mavericks to win 2024 NBA Finals|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/boston-celtics-beat-dallas-mavericks-2024-nba-finals/|publisher=cbsnews.com|access-date=June 17, 2024|date=June 17, 2024}} Prosper made 52 appearances (four starts) for Dallas during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 3.9 points, 2.4 rebounds, and 0.8 assists. On March 7, 2025, it was announced that Prosper would require season-ending surgery to repair ligament damage in his right wrist.{{cite web | title=Mavericks' Olivier-Maxence Prosper expected to have season-ending surgery, per report | website=Dallas News | date=2025-03-07 | url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/mavericks/2025/03/07/mavericks-olivier-maxence-prosper-expected-to-have-season-ending-surgery-per-report/?outputType=amp | access-date=2025-12-06}} On September 2, Prosper was waived by the Mavericks.{{Cite web |date=2 September 2025|title=Mavs re-sign Dante Exum|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavs-re-sign-dante-exum/|access-date=2 September 2025|website=mavs.com}} On September 4, 2025, Prosper signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies sign Olivier-Maxence Prosper to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-olivier-maxence-prosper-to-two-way-contract|access-date=September 8, 2025|website=nba.com|language=es}} On February 7, 2026, Prosper scored a career-high 25 points in addition to five rebounds in a loss to the [[2025–26 Portland Trail Blazers season|Portland Trail Blazers]].{{Cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies vs Portland Trail Blazers Feb 7, 2026 Box Scores|url=https://www.nba.com/game/mem-vs-por-0022500755/box-score|access-date=March 4, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}} On March 4, the Grizzlies signed Prosper to a standard, two-year NBA contract.{{Cite web|title=Grizzlies sign forward Olivier-Maxence Prosper to multi-year contract|url=https://www.nba.com/news/grizzlies-sign-forward-olivier-maxence-prosper-to-multi-year-contract|access-date=March 4, 2026|website=nba.com|language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player
